## Learning Objectives{.fragments}
::: incremental
By the end of this session, you should be able to:

-   Understand R and R-Studio basics
-   Install and load R packages
-   Create and render R Markdown/Quarto documents
-   Perform basic data wrangling using `dplyr` and `tidyr`
-   Understand data frames and variables in R
:::


------------------------------------------------------------------------

## R and R-Studio {.smaller}

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
**R**: Open-source programming language for statistical computing and graphics

-   Extensive libraries for data analysis, visualization, machine learning
-   Widely used in academia and industry, especially in healthcare analytics
:::
:::{.column width="50%"}
**R-Studio**: Integrated Development Environment (IDE) for R

-   User-friendly interface with script editor, console, environment pane, and plots pane
-   Facilitates project management, package installation, and version control
:::
:::::

[![](images/image1.png){fig-align="center" width=80%}](https://moderndive.com/v2/getting-started.html){target="_blank"}

::: notes
Discuss the advantages of using R and R-Studio for healthcare data analysis. Mention its open-source
nature and strong community support.
:::
